content: We have carbon NMR peaks: 10 signals. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm. In list: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31 are in that region. That's six signals. But some could be other carbons like CH2 or quaternary. Need to identify which are methyl. Could also use proton NMR to see number of methyl protons. Let's get proton NMR.
